statement: From ondelta epoch 1 the empty state (offdelta 0, no clause, nonce = stored + 1, Right author, floor windows) is a valid dispute start proof with no signature and settles at ondelta; signed frames outrank it through counters; a counter's windows may lengthen, never shorten.

killers.name: R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: after a settlement a side with no signed proof of the new epoch can start, and the dispute settles at ondelta
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: two disputes in a row, and a third, each starts from nothing (Q-D-21)
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: a signed frame of the epoch outranks it through a counter, and it settles instead
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: at its own nonce a Left-authored signed proof outranks it, a Right-authored one ties and does not (the Runtime starts a new epoch's proofs at stored + 2)
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: a counter may carry longer windows than the implicit proof's, and the final body may too
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: a counter may never SHORTEN the dispute's windows (a signed start at 300 s, a counter at 60 s)
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: a start at a dead epoch is still skipped with reason 11, a stale nonce and an open dispute as before
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: only the canonical implicit proof starts without a signature
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: at epoch 0 there is no implicit proof (a fresh account's first frames are its proofs)
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: a signed start is checked as before (a wrong signature is E4)
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: an immediate close with a fresh signed body that SHORTENS a window is refused (E9), at each window on its own
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: the same immediate close with a LONGER final body lands (windows may lengthen)
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: the non-starter's IMMEDIATE close ranks like a counter: Left-authored at stored + 1 closes, Right-authored at stored + 1 does not
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: stored + 2 outranks the implicit proof at either author, through a counter and through an immediate close
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: after a timeout close the next implicit start is at the NEW stored + 1, a Right-authored proof there only ties and the first signed proof is at the new stored + 2
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: a counter at the implicit nonce with Left authorship replaces it, and a later Right-authored counter at stored + 2 replaces THAT (ordering of several counters)
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: every NON-canonical unsigned start on a stale epoch, a stale nonce or an open dispute is SKIPPED, never reverted
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: a stranger with no co-signed history (epoch 0) cannot open a dispute against any entity, funded or not
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: an implicit start that names NO token, or a subset, settles only what it names and still ends the epoch
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: the implicit proof cannot be replayed into a later epoch (its start is skipped once the Account has moved)
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: a canonical body with a non-empty signature that does not verify reverts at every length (1, 32, 64, 65 bytes), never taken as the implicit proof
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: every token of the body is held to offdelta 0 (a nonzero in the middle of three is refused)
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: the non-starter has exactly 2 x floor to counter (119 s lands, 120 s is skipped), and the starter cannot finalize before it
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: Delta = ondelta above the collateral (Right took more than its share) is paid from RIGHT's reserves, in full, by an implicit dispute started by either side
R-IMPLICIT-BASELINE: Delta = ondelta below zero (Left took more than its claim) is paid from LEFT's reserves, in full
